title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 440 Arapahoe Street in Thermopolis, Wyoming, as the "Robert L. Brown Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 440 Arapahoe Street in Thermopolis, Wyoming, as the "Robert L. Brown Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named the post office at 440 Arapahoe Street in Thermopolis, Wyoming, after Robert L. Brown.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a specific United States Postal Service building in Thermopolis, Wyoming, as the Robert L. Brown Post Office. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change postal services, rules, or how the building operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 30, 2020.
